Rashid Khan: Heads up 1 0 candidate: Mei Chen (Singapore)  needs final interview this Fri 18:3019:30 SGT due to current job shift. Onsite SF is not possible. Asking for remote; also requested Mandarin interpreter. Can we support interpreter + loaner if needed?
Emi Tanaka: I can cover hiring manager wrap if we do remote. Time's tight but I have 18:1519:45 SGT available.
Liam O'Connor: Interviewer for backend takehome + live coding. 18:30 SGT works for me. Will need CoderPad link and clear instructions for test env.
Hannah Park: People-ops: we have a vendor for on-call interpreters (LinguaLive). Rates apply, usually need 48h notice. Also note Redwood Zoom licensed accounts support live captioning but not third-party interpreter channels without a simultaneous interpreter add-on.
Rashid Khan: OK noted. Candidate prefers Mandarin. Do we have budget for interpreter? If not, candidate can have an internal PM translate but prefers pro.
people-ops-bot: Budget check: Current hiring ops discretionary fund balance: EUR 2,350. Interpreter estimate: ~EUR 120 for a 2-hour booking + buffer. Loaner laptop shipping EMI: usually EUR 45 (SG).
Liam O'Connor: For the coding piece, candidate will need internet access on their side; loaner only needed if they request. I'd rather avoid shipping internationally unless necessary. Can we offer test on candidate's machine with screenshare + CoderPad?
Emi Tanaka: Candidate mentioned possible network instability at home. She asked if we could offer an office room in Singapore on Saturday afternoon instead, but travel would be difficult that close.
Hannah Park: Proposal: do remote interview on Friday as scheduled with interpreter via LinguaLive. Enable Zoom captions and record transcript. Offer a loaner in SG only if candidate requests and signs LOA. Approve interpreter cost from discretionary fund.
Rashid Khan: Sounds good. Mei also asked for soft-switch keyboard preference (US layout) and hearing captioning. She uses simplified Chinese for chat. Can we add translation note in the invite and set Zoom language to Chinese for auto-transcript?
people-ops-bot: Reminder: auto-transcript language auto-detect may not be reliable. Best to set "Transcription language: Chinese (Mandarin)" on the Zoom event.
Liam O'Connor: Logistics checklist: 1) CoderPad link + instructions, 2) Zoom event with captions + interpreter channel, 3) Interpreter booking confirmation, 4) LOA if loaner needed, 5) Calendar invites with Mandarin/English notes.
Hannah Park: I'll book LinguaLive now for Fri 18:2019:50 SGT. Need candidate contact number for interpreter call-in and time confirmation. Also creating LOA template for loaner (one-pager).
Rashid Khan: Candidate contact: +65 9123 4567. Address (only if loaner): Mei Chen, 88 Orchard Rd #12-34, Singapore 238876. Mei's pronouns: she/her. She confirmed Friday 18:30 SGT preferred.
people-ops-bot: Interpreter booked (LinguaLive booking ID LL-4421). Est. charge EUR 130. Invoice to be routed to hiring-squad.
Hannah Park: LOA draft attached to thread (sent via DM). Also, I added a 10-minute buffer before the session for interpreter setup and a 15-minute buffer after for debrief. Proposed timeline: 18:2018:30 interpreter warm-up, 18:3019:30 interviews (coding + system), 19:3019:45 HM wrap + debrief.
Liam O'Connor: Please add CoderPad instructions in both EN and ZH to the invite: sample snippet: 
```
Coding instructions:
- Use CoderPad link provided
- Timebox: 45 minutes
- Share results via GitHub gist afterwards (optional)
```
Emi Tanaka: I'll be on the panel and will add bilingual notes. Can we also enable Zoom closed captions and record transcript in Chinese? Mei prefers written English feedback too.
Rashid Khan: I'll send candidate confirmation message now (excerpt): "Thanks Mei 10 we have your interview Fri 18:30 SGT with live Mandarin interpreter and captions. Please confirm phone for interpreter and whether you'd like a loaner laptop. We'll send LOA if needed."
people-ops-bot: Calendar event created: https://calendar.redwood.ai/events/1865009876  invites pending until LOA signed (if loaner requested).
Hannah Park: Interpreter confirmation email sent to Mei and LinguaLive. LOA template sent to hiring leads. I've also flagged Security to approve temporary remote access token for loaner if used.
Rashid Khan: Mei replied: "Thank you, I confirm phone number and I do NOT need a loaner unless connection degrades. Looking forward to Friday."
Liam O'Connor: Great. I'll prepare CoderPad and paste link to the calendar event.
Emi Tanaka: All set. Thanks everyone :smile: 
DevOps-bot: Reminder scheduled: Send pre-interview checklist to candidate 24 hours prior.
